dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm interested in history. Where should I go?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ˈhɪstəri. ˈwɛr ʃʊd aɪ ˈɡoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sukhothai. It's known for its historical park.
dialogue.reading: ˌsuːkoʊˈtaɪ. ɪts ˈnoʊn fər ɪts hɪˈstɔːrɪkəl ˈpɑːrk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The ruins of old temples. Some are more than seven hundred years old.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈruːɪnz əv ˈoʊld ˈtɛmpəlz. sʌm ər ˈmɔːr ðən ˈsɛvən ˈhʌndrəd ˈjɪrz ˈoʊld.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Amazing. Is Sukhothai famous for anything else?
dialogue.reading: əˈmeɪzɪŋ. ɪz ˌsuːkoʊˈtaɪ ˈfeɪməs fər ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɛls?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's famous for Loy Krathong. The festival there is beautiful.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ˈfeɪməs fər ˈlɔɪ krəˈtɔːŋ. ðə ˈfɛstɪvəl ˈðɛr ɪz ˈbjuːtəfəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It sounds like an important place.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈsaʊndz laɪk ən ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ˈpleɪs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It is. It's an important part of Thai heritage, and it's on UNESCO's World Heritage list.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɪz. ɪts ən ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ˈpɑːrt əv ˈtaɪ ˈhɛrɪtɪdʒ, ənd ɪts ɑːn juːˈnɛskoʊz ˈwɜːrld ˈhɛrɪtɪdʒ ˈlɪst.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'd also like to buy some souvenirs.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈlaɪk tə ˈbaɪ sʌm ˌsuːvəˈnɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then go to Chiang Mai. It's known for its handicrafts, like painted umbrellas and silk.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈɡoʊ tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ. ɪts ˈnoʊn fər ɪts ˈhændikræfts, laɪk ˈpeɪntɪd ʌmˈbrɛləz ənd ˈsɪlk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You know so much about Thailand, Nam!
dialogue.reading: juː ˈnoʊ ˈsoʊ ˈmʌtʃ əˈbaʊt ˈtaɪlænd, ˈnɑːm!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My parents are teachers, so I learned a lot as a child!
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈpɛrənts ər ˈtiːtʃərz, soʊ aɪ ˈlɜːrnd ə ˈlɑːt əz ə ˈtʃaɪld!
